postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Pošta Slovenije CSV row or separately permitted operator receipt establishes a four-digit postal code and post-office assignment at capture time. Syntax, an office location, place name, address point, or web search result does not establish current allocation, perimeter, or deliverability.
postal_system.special_code_rule: Pošta Slovenije special postal codes assigned to organizations, institutions, postal centres, or other named users are non-area by default and never receive invented residential polygons.
postal_system.postal_district_rule: The GURS Register prostorskih enot contains an official poštni okoliš spatial-unit class. It is government register geometry, not automatically a Pošta Slovenije-authored current postcode perimeter. Postal area output requires a versioned explicit operator code/post-office to GURS postal-district identifier crosswalk; names, centroids, containment, buffers, and Voronoi cells never substitute.
postal_system.delivery_area_rule: Pošta Slovenije WebGIS areas for unaddressed direct mail and A/B/C pricing are operational delivery-service geometry. They remain separate from normal postcode assignment, GURS postal districts, addressed-mail deliverability, and redistribution rights.
postal_system.address_rule: The GURS Register naslovov is the address-identity authority. Its unique address number, municipality, settlement, street, house number and suffix, optional apartment or business-premise number, centroid, validity, source date, CC BY 4.0 attribution, schema, EPSG:3794 CRS and digest remain separate from Pošta Slovenije assignment evidence.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires the source-defined Register naslovov or Kataster nepremičnin address-building relationship, a common authoritative identifier, or a reviewed explicit crosswalk. An address centroid inside a footprint, parcel overlap, containment, or nearest building is candidate evidence only.
postal_system.parcel_rule: Cadastral parcel geometry and identifiers are validation context only. A parcel is not a building, address link, postal district, delivery guarantee, or permission to publish owners, rightsholders, occupants, title, value, encumbrance, or restriction records.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Municipalities, settlements, administrative units, statistical regions, streets and community units remain separately sourced context. They do not create postcode membership or delivery coverage.
postal_system.crs_rule: Every GURS geometry retains source CRS EPSG:3794 and the exact reviewed transform/version used for WGS84 API output.
postal_system.service_status_rule: Post-office operation, unaddressed-mail coverage, special-code use, route availability, postcode-list availability, and delivery eligibility are time-stamped operational assertions separate from assignment, geometry, address identity, and administration.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> crosswalk-qualified postal district or rights-cleared address point -> address graph -> explicit cadastral building relation -> AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical four digits -> operator assignment -> optional crosswalk-qualified postal district or derived surface -> address hierarchy -> explicit building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: source-defined relation, common authoritative identifier, or reviewed explicit crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: Postal codes remain four-character text without losing leading zeroes; optional SI- input is normalized but is not stored as part of the code.
Every official government postal surface retains the Pošta Slovenije assignment, GURS postal-district identifier, explicit crosswalk version, validity, CRS, attribution and digests.
Organization, institution, postal-centre and other special codes are non-area unless separately proven otherwise.
WebGIS unaddressed-mail delivery areas never silently become normal postcode polygons or deliverability claims.
Each exact address retains a GURS address number, components, centroid, validity, release, attribution, CRS, digest and separate postal assignment evidence.
Building output has a source-defined or reviewed identifier relation; address-centroid containment and proximity alone never pass.
No addressee, resident, owner, rightsholder, occupant, title/value record, phone, credential, or delivery instruction is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned Pošta Slovenije normal and special-code releases pass terms, freshness, correction and non-area classification gates.
GURS address, postal-district and cadastral resources pass licence, attribution, schema, CRS, coverage, validity, privacy and correction gates.
Explicit postal-district crosswalks, derived surfaces and building joins pass topology, ambiguity, identifier, licence and quality gates.
